answer_1.quote: this paper focuses on the capabilities of ChatGPT in translating English poetry into modern Chinese poetry

answer_2.quote: For our automatic evaluation, we used SacreBLEU, BERTScore to evaluate the performance of different candidate translations

answer_3.quote: we employed GPT-4 to evaluate various translations based on the human evaluation criteria we established

answer_4.quote: we engaged a panel of professional poets for assessments
answer_4.guideline: Evaluation based on eight criteria: Overall Impression, Similarity, Fidelity, Line-breaking, Meaningfulness, Poeticity, Accuracy, and Errors using a 6-point scale
